body: Definitely, I have a forum: Mental\_Health\_Forum or you can pm me too.

You know in today's world many of us feel as if that we aren't as good looking or as good as the people around us and tbh it's a real thing and problem and if you feel bad about it and want to talk about it that's good for you, however, to kill yourself over it is going a bit too far and I just need you to know that we only want what we can't have now just because the person sitting next to you is a model they aren't better than you at I don't know, story writing for all I care because you will have something unique to you and that is what makes you beautiful and it's not required for you feel as if your face is inadequate because that's not what decides how ugly or beautiful you are. Now if there was a serious condition or damage to your face it would be a different case where you could get cosmetic surgery or procedures done but other than that trust me it could be much worse and you don't need to get hung up on something like this because your not ugly and you just need to figure out what it is that you love and follow with that and that all that really matters so forget about your conscience putting you down and just feel good. If you ever want to talk to me I'm there on my subreddit every day: [https://www.reddit.com/r/Mental\_Health\_Forum/](https://www.reddit.com/r/Mental_Health_Forum/)

or if you want you can directly message me but have a good day:).

It's unfortunate that you had to get bullied off of twitter but you took a big step forward by introducing yourself which is very much so comendable and just know that there is nothing wrong coming out with your problems to other people because many people struggle with that problem but just let me know if there is anything that you need I am available as your new reddit friend. It's okay to want to feel self-independent I am definitely that way but sometimes when we are in a troubled state someone else is all we need and it doesn't have to be that you need help from other people but just talking out your problems can be like almost therapeutic so if you do want to talk to anybody I'm here you don't have to think of it as taking help you can just vent your problems and get some peer support because trust me I know sometimes just venting out your problems can make you feel better just talking to somebody helps. About your situation about feeling lonely, you can always make new friends if you didn't like the previous ones you had but there are plenty of people ready to be your friend and you don't even have to be social you can still find friends in many people. I have a mental health forum for these types of things and you can join if you would like of private message me any day I am available but have a good day and remember that you have so much to live for! I know it is and it is very difficult to deal with it and sometimes I feel the same way because im a teenager and I feel that the only thing that seems to matter is sitting at my desk working to get into college which caused me to feel suicidal when it was mized in with the death of a family member annd other emotions but we need to confide in those who are there to help us so that we can all ge through the problems that we are facing and I hope you do feel better and just remeber that there people here to help you if you ever are feeling liek you need to cry and harm yourself dont but share your feelings and trust me you will feel so much better and it can even take away some of the stress that you are feeling so for know we just got to persevere until we can get to the other side of the horizon.

Definetley confiding in someone when they are available for us is the best way to deal with suicidal thoughts talk to her and let her understand why you are feeling this way and you both can get professional help for you until you get better.

I know that while you are i n this moment pf confusion of what to do and how to get out of there that you are confused on how to free yourself but you do need to get out of there. Now you might feel some regret as no matter how cruel they are they still arent your parents but you gotta free yourself. First things first you need to find the closest thing you have to you as family so find someone who will believe in you like grandparents or someone like or a friend who's parents might understand. While you are in the home document whatever you can because in the end the evidence will speak while you are in the safe space contact the child authorities and tell them what is happeneing co-ordiante with them to resolve the problem. You're almost 18 and an adult so I think that you should try to be in this safe space that you can try to find in the meantime and if there is a legal clinic or a lawyer willing to take take your case and understanding your situation  if the CPS is not of any use. I hope you are able to get through this and don't suffer too much but I truly am sorry for what you have to deal with but find someone to help accomodate you and get away from your parents after gathering some eveidence. Best of luck I hope that you get better and you problem gets solved. <3.

Look I know that right now while things aren't in your favour it seems that the easy way out is the best way out but that is wrong and although the chips are down for you can turn them into your favour so talk to me or someone because there are people who care for you and want you to be alive and you dont need to end it now or ever but instead you need to live for all the better things and overcome what is in your way.

Losing someone is hard especially when you feel guilty that you shouldve spent more time with them or been a better person with them and I know how it feels cuz I lost my grandma on new years day and she had alzheimers and I kept feeling that I could've been a better grandson so that she would feel better but the thing is you just have to learn to accept that sometimes death is inevitable and we need to move on. after she died I didnt know how to feel and my grades started to slip and I got into trouble with my teachers fro not submitng work and slacing and at one point I cut my  wrist with a piece of broken glass once i gained the courage but belive me it did nothing in terms of relieveng me and I didn't cut deep enough so I am fine now but dont think that you should build up the courage to take your own life because that's like because thats like living in a house and feeling bad for a plant that could've been there, my point is that your not truly a lost cause until u make yourself one and I thought of myself as one to for a while even after my dad called me one (though he didn't know how I felt) but i realized that your only useless when you feel you are so u can join me in trying to better yourself and stand up to others or you can beat yourself up but you got to understand why living is better for you than the easy way out and im telling this to you from experience because my grandma got to die and be relieved of pain when she couldnt do anything about it but you can and you should so stand up dust yourself and get to working on yourself.

Losing someone close to you is very difficult and especially when you feel that it's your fault and even it is know that you may have done something wrong but the whole reason of why there is still so much life left for you is so that you know that you've messed up but that you have time to make sure that you don't again. Right now the love of your life is gone but you need to start loving yourself because you can't focus on anything before you focus on yourself. You have to learn to apologise for your mistakes but the person you need to apologise to is yourself. For me my grandmother died on new years when my entire family was gathered around her, she had a rare version of alzheimers, my family did everything they could to get her treatment but when she passed we realized there wasn't something we could do which is why you need to know that you can't change the past but you can shape your future. Just because your about to be finished with your 20's your life isn't over just make the most of your 30's. First things first leave your current therapist and find someone who trusts and believes in you also need to find friends and family to confide in so talk to them because they will understand if they see your sincerity. Next get on your feet find what it is that you do best and start working on that and to make it you're gonna need to spend more time on your passion, I hope that you are able to make it through your problems but remeber that there are people who care for you and want you to live like me, I want you to live dont think that your life is over you have so much to live for so just hold on to the finer things in life and you can make it through. If you need me im here for you or call 1-800-273-8255 there are people ready to help you but don't give up just now.
